components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary commitment action, currently used for starting compression.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c8963e; color: #12100e; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 24px; font: 700 15px/1.3 Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d9a84c; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5c4a2e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Strategy Row
components.description: Compact selectable strategy row with technical name and CPU/GPU/COPY tag.
components.css: .ds-strategy-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; width: 100%; background: #1c1a16; color: #c8c0b8; border: 1px solid #d4a853; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 8px; font: 400 12px/1.3 Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-tag { color: #8a857c; font-size: 11px; } .ds-strategy-row:hover { background: #24221d; }

components.name: Protected Source Status
components.description: Non-actionable skip label for HEVC/HDR/Dolby Vision sources.
components.css: .ds-skip-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #1c1a16; color: #5b8db8; border: 1px solid #2e2b25; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 8px; font: 600 12px/1.3 Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Default raised field for search, paths, and technical settings.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #24221d; color: #e8e3db; border: 1px solid #2e2b25; border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 8px; font: 400 13px/1.4 Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #c8963e; outline: none; }

narrative.overview: LeanReel is a precise desktop workbench for media decisions. It is dense, warm, restrained, and built around safe batch judgment rather than spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark neutral surfaces with one amber action accent.
Status vocabulary that combines color, text, and affordance.
Technical strategy names with short explanatory copy.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is for action, focus, and selected state. Do not use amber as decoration.

rules.name: The Protected Source Rule
rules.body: HEVC/H.265, HDR10, HDR10+ and Dolby Vision should use an informational skip treatment, not a warning treatment.

rules.name: The No Display Type Rule
rules.body: Product labels, buttons, table headers, queue rows, and status text use the system sans stack.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Tables, panels, toolbars, and strategy rows are flat by default. Use borders and tonal changes for separation.

dos: Do keep the three-pane layout as the default mental model: library, files, strategy.
Do show protected-source skip reasons plainly.
Do use technical strategy names, then explain in one short sentence.
Do keep amber rare and meaningful.
donts: Don't rename technical strategies back to vague labels like 轻量压缩, 均衡压缩, or 极限压缩.
Don't process HEVC/H.265, HDR10, HDR10+ or Dolby Vision through default UI paths.
Don't use landing-page patterns, hero sections, decorative cards, or identical card grids.
Don't use purple-blue gradients, glassmorphism, glow borders, or gradient text.
